title: Enterprise pricing tailored to your environment
subtitle: SecureHive is licensed for enterprise deployments. Pricing depends on scope, integrations, and support requirements.
planDesc: We work with security and procurement teams to define the right combination of identity, access, endpoint, and cloud capabilities. Contact us for a proposal based on your environment.
faq1A: Licensing is typically based on the scope of deployment and selected product areas. Our team will recommend a structure that matches your environment.
faq2Q: Can we start with a pilot?
faq2A: Yes. Many organizations begin with a focused pilot around identity or privileged access before expanding.
faq3A: Implementation and advisory services can be included as part of an enterprise engagement. Details are provided during the proposal process.
ctaSubtitle: Tell us about your systems, user counts, and compliance timeline — we will draft a licensing proposal.
